text:
Hannah Li: Quick announcement: we're changing how minute grace windows and free credits behave starting next month. This is a billing-policy/UX change (no unit price increases). :loudspeaker:

Hannah Li: High level:
- Hourly cushion: new accounts will get a short hourly cushion (replaces the per-minute grace) to smooth transient microbursts. Existing accounts keep the current minute grace for 45 days before auto-migrating.
- Credit partitioning: promotional/free credits will be partitioned into route-labeled buckets (chat, embeddings, fine-tune) to prevent expensive routes from draining shared credits.
- Preview mode: customers can preview their post-migration balances in Console -> Billing before we migrate.

Marcus Green: Technical notes: the cushion is implemented in the metering pipeline as an hourly rolling allowance that only absorbs small spikes. It will not mask sustained over-usage. Feature flag billing.hourly_cushion.v1 created and off by default.

Ravi Srinivasan: Migration plan:
- Day 0: enable preview UI + API for all customers (read-only).
- Day 3: start dry-run for 10k customers (no invoice effects).
- Day 10: full migration; migration job will emit an invoice annotation "billing.migration_note" for the first affected cycle.

Jules Park: Support KB snippets (brief):
- "Will my credits vanish?" -> No. Credits are redistributed into labeled buckets pro-rata and a small cushion is added for new accounts.
- "Will I be charged immediately?" -> No sudden charges. The migration might reveal a route cap you didn't hit before; Support can request a temporary cross-route allowance.

Hannah Li: Finance note: we'll add a non-dollar invoice line item "credit_partition_adjustment" to help with reconciliation during the first two billing cycles. No retroactive billing. Tax treatment unchanged for now; Finance will confirm.

billing-bot: Automated: feature_flag billing.credit_partition.v1 created, owner=@marcus, audit_id=bb-2459000000.

Marcus Green: API preview call for customers: 

curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/billing/credits?preview=partitioned"

Ravi Srinivasan: Action items:
- @jules: KB + canned responses (ETA 48h)
- @finance: confirm invoice annotation formatting (ETA 48h)
- @devex: add preview card in Console (ETA 72h)
- @support: add escalation path for cross-route allowances (ETA 48h)

Jules Park: Will draft KB and post in #support later today. :white_check_mark:

Hannah Li: Dedicated/Private customers: unchanged unless they opt in; we'll provide an opt-in toggle on the appliance UI.

Marcus Green: Telemetry ask: billing.partition.migrated_count, billing.hourly_cushion.absorbed_tokens, billing.cushion.fallback_events. @eng-infra please add.

Hannah Li: We'll send customer comms 72h before full migration and display a Console banner. Please DM me quickly if you object to the timing. Closing thread for now.
